intro_en: You will learn to give imaginary advice with "If I were you, I would..." and talk about big choices like changing jobs, moving, or studying abroad. You will also practice the Mongolian pattern -сан бол + -х байсан.
intro_mn: Та "If I were you, I would..." бүтцээр төсөөллийн зөвлөгөө өгөх, ажил солих, нүүх, гадаадад сурах зэрэг чухал сонголтуудын тухай ярьж сурна. Мөн "-сан бол + -х байсан" хэлбэрийг дадлагажуулна.

vocab.example_en: He decided to move to the city center.
I am thinking about changing jobs.
The salary at the new job is higher.

vocab.example_mn: Орон сууны түрээс их үнэтэй байна.
vocab.example_en: The apartment rent is very expensive.

vocab.example_mn: Энэ ажилд бага зэрэг эрсдэл бий.
vocab.example_en: There is some risk in this job.
She got a scholarship to study in Korea.
Don't hesitate, just give it a try.

sentences.mn: Би чиний оронд байсан бол ажлаа солих байсан.
sentences.en: If I were you, I would change jobs.
alt_en: If I were in your place, I would change jobs.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi chinii orond baisan bol ajlaa solikh baisan.

sentences.mn: Би чиний оронд байсан бол тэр шийдвэрийг хүлээж авахгүй байсан.
sentences.en: If I were you, I wouldn't accept that decision.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi chinii orond baisan bol ter shiidveriig khüleej avakhgüi baisan.

sentences.mn: Хэрвээ би түүний оронд байсан бол хөдөө нүүх байсан.
sentences.en: If I were him, I would move to the countryside.
alt_en: If I were in his place, I would move to the countryside.
sentences.mn_latin: Khervee bi tüünii orond baisan bol khödöö nüükh baisan.

sentences.mn: Цалин сайн байсан бол би тэр ажлыг сонгох байсан.
sentences.en: If the salary were good, I would choose that job.
alt_mn: Цалин өндөр байсан бол би тэр ажлыг сонгох байсан.
alt_en: If the pay were good, I would pick that job.
sentences.mn_latin: Tsalin sain baisan bol bi ter ajlyg songokh baisan.

sentences.mn: Түрээс ийм үнэтэй биш байсан бол бид хотод үлдэх байсан.
sentences.en: If the rent weren't so expensive, we would stay in the city.
alt_en: If the rent were not this expensive, we would stay in the city.
sentences.mn_latin: Türees iim ünetei bish baisan bol bid khotod üldekh baisan.

sentences.mn: Чи тэтгэлэг авсан бол гадаадад сурах байсан уу?
sentences.en: If you had gotten a scholarship, would you have studied abroad?
alt_mn: Чамд тэтгэлэг олдсон бол гадаадад сурах байсан уу?
alt_en: If you had been given a scholarship, would you have studied abroad?
sentences.mn_latin: Chi tetgeleg avsan bol gadaadad surakh baisan uu?

sentences.mn: Би чиний оронд байсан бол удаан эргэлзэхгүй байсан.
sentences.en: If I were you, I wouldn't hesitate for long.
alt_en: If I were in your place, I wouldn't hesitate for long.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi chinii orond baisan bol udaan ergelzekhgüi baisan.

sentences.mn: Багш чиний оронд байсан бол магистрт элсэх байсан.
sentences.en: If the teacher were in your place, he would enroll in a master's program.
alt_mn: Багш чиний оронд байсан бол магистрт орох байсан.
alt_en: If the teacher were you, he would do a master's degree.
sentences.mn_latin: Bagsh chinii orond baisan bol magistrt elsekh baisan.

sentences.mn: Энэ том эрсдэл боловч би оролдох байсан.
sentences.en: This is a big risk, but I would try.
alt_mn: Энэ том эрсдэл ч гэсэн би оролдох байсан.
alt_en: It is a big risk, but I would give it a try.
sentences.mn_latin: Ene tom ersdel bolovch bi oroldokh baisan.

sentences.mn: Бид тэдний оронд байсан бол эхлээд зөвлөгөө авах байсан.
sentences.en: If we were them, we would ask for advice first.
alt_en: If we were in their place, we would get advice first.
sentences.mn_latin: Bid tednii orond baisan bol ekhleed zövlögöö avakh baisan.

sentences.mn: Миний сонголт өөр байсан бол одоо би өөр хотод амьдрах байсан.
sentences.en: If my choice had been different, I would be living in another city now.
alt_en: If I had made a different choice, I would be living in another city now.
sentences.mn_latin: Minii songolt öör baisan bol odoo bi öör khotod amidrakh baisan.

sentences.mn: Би чиний оронд байсан бол эцэг эхтэйгээ эхлээд ярилцах байсан.
sentences.en: If I were you, I would talk to your parents first.
alt_en: If I were in your shoes, I would talk to your parents first.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi chinii orond baisan bol etseg ekhteigee ekhleed yariltsakh baisan.

grammar.title_mn: Төсөөллийн зөвлөгөө: If I were you, I would...
grammar.explain_en: To say "If I were you, I would...", Mongolian uses the condition ending -сан/-сэн/-сон/-сөн бол (or байсан бол) and then a verb stem + -х байсан for the imagined result: Би чиний оронд байсан бол нүүх байсан. "Чиний оронд" means "in your place". You can add хэрвээ (if) at the start for emphasis. The ending follows vowel harmony: авсан бол, өгсөн бол, сонссон бол. English uses "were" for every subject in this type of sentence: if I were, if he were, if she were, if we were. Then use would + base verb.
grammar.explain_mn: Монгол хэлний "-сан/-сэн/-сон/-сөн бол" (эсвэл "байсан бол") + "үйл + -х байсан" бүтэц нь англи хэлний "If I were you, I would..." бүтэцтэй таарна. "Чиний оронд" нь "in your place" гэсэн утгатай. Англи хэлэнд бодит бус нөхцөлд бүх субъекттэй "was" биш "were" хэрэглэнэ: If I were, if he were, if she were, if it were, if we were. Үр дүнгийн хэсэгт would + үйлийн үндсэн хэлбэр орно. Жишээ нь: If I were you, I would move. Сөрөг: I wouldn't quit. Асуулт: What would you do if you were me?

examples.mn: Би чиний оронд байсан бол нүүх байсан.
examples.en: If I were you, I would move.
examples.mn_latin: Bi chinii orond baisan bol nüükh baisan.

examples.mn: Тэр миний оронд байсан бол ажлаа солихгүй байсан.
examples.en: If she were in my place, she wouldn't change jobs.
examples.mn_latin: Ter minii orond baisan bol ajlaa solikhgüi baisan.

examples.mn: Бид түүний оронд байсан бол тэтгэлэгт хүсэлт гаргах байсан.
examples.en: If we were in his place, we would apply for the scholarship.
examples.mn_latin: Bid tüünii orond baisan bol tetgelegt khüselt gargakh baisan.

examples.mn: Чи миний оронд байсан бол яах байсан бэ?
examples.en: What would you do if you were me?
examples.mn_latin: Chi minii orond baisan bol yaakh baisan be?

dialogue.speaker: Saruul
dialogue.mn: Би ажлаа солих эсэхээ шийдэж чадахгүй байна.
dialogue.en: I can't decide whether to change my job.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bi ajlaa solikh esekhee shiidej chadakhgüi baina.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.en: How much is the salary at the new job?

dialogue.speaker: Saruul
dialogue.mn: Илүү өндөр, гэхдээ эрсдэл бий. Компани шинэ.
dialogue.en: It's higher, but there is some risk. The company is new.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ilüü öndör, gekhdee ersdel bii. Kompani shine.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Би чиний оронд байсан бол оролдох байсан.
dialogue.en: If I were you, I would try.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bi chinii orond baisan bol oroldokh baisan.

dialogue.speaker: Saruul
dialogue.mn: Харин чи миний оронд байсан бол эхлээд гэр бүлтэйгээ ярилцахгүй байсан юм уу?
dialogue.en: But if you were me, wouldn't you talk to your family first?
dialogue.mn_latin: Kharin chi minii orond baisan bol ekhleed ger bülteigee yariltsakhgüi baisan yum uu?

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Мэдээж ярилцах байсан. Тэгээд л шийдвэрээ гаргах байсан.
dialogue.en: Of course I would. Then I would make my decision.
dialogue.mn_latin: Medeej yariltsakh baisan. Tegeed l shiidveree gargakh baisan.

culture_note.en: In Mongolia, big choices such as moving from the countryside to Ulaanbaatar, changing jobs, or studying abroad are often discussed with parents and relatives. Many young people hope for scholarships to study in Korea, Japan, Germany, or the US. Friends usually give advice gently, and "If I were you..." is a polite way to share an opinion without pushing.
culture_note.mn: Монголд хөдөөнөөс Улаанбаатарт нүүх, ажил солих, гадаадад сурах зэрэг чухал шийдвэрийг эцэг эх, төрөл садантайгаа хэлэлцдэг заншилтай. Залуус Солонгос, Япон, Герман, АНУ-д сурах тэтгэлэг авахыг их хүсдэг. Найзууд зөвлөгөөг зөөлөн өгдөг бөгөөд "Би чиний оронд байсан бол..." гэдэг нь хүнд дарамт үзүүлэхгүйгээр санаагаа хэлэх эелдэг арга юм.

review.notes: Mostly good, but several Mongolian conditions and English translations mismatched real vs. counterfactual meaning, and some alt strings were duplicates.

opus_fix.notes: Fixed duplicate or wrong alternatives, apply/enroll mismatches, distractor forms, and real vs. hypothetical verb forms in the dialogue.

changes.why: Alternative was identical to the main sentence
Alternative was identical to the main sentence
'байр суурьт' means 'in his position/stance', not 'in his place'
'wouldn't doubt for long' is unnatural English
'тэтгэлэгт хамрагдах' means receive the scholarship, not apply for it
Bring the mn explanation in line with the en version (pattern, чиний оронд)
Distractors must follow vowel harmony with нүү-
Informal 'was' is also widely accepted, so the answer was not the only correct option
The imagined question needs the -х байсан form
'ярилцана' is a real future, not the hypothetical 'would'
'дарамт болгохгүйгээр' is ungrammatical; the phrase is 'дарамт үзүүлэх'
